name: University User
description: Any authenticated person who belongs to the university (student, professor, or academic‑administrator). The role and identity are required before any protected operation can be performed.

name: Student
description: A university user whose primary goal is to manage personal enrollment – searching offerings, registering, swapping, dropping, viewing schedules, and handling wait‑list entries.

name: Professor
description: A university user whose goal is to review the course offerings assigned to them and see the current rosters of enrolled students.

name: Academic Administrator
description: A university user responsible for configuring the academic calendar (terms and registration periods) and for creating, publishing, updating, or canceling course offerings, including instructor assignment and capacity settings.
